contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #031: Uchida’s conjecture for open homomorphisms of Galois groups.

Audit of the uniform missed-prime bridge in the staged October 5, 2026 manuscript. K is a number field, B=Q(i), beta_B:G_K->P_B is a continuous surjection, ell is odd, and log(chi_ell o beta_B)=log(chi_K,ell). These are hypotheses here, not conclusions of this mission.

definitions.epsilon: (chi_ell o beta_B)/chi_K,ell, a finite character with values in mu_(ell-1)
definitions.Kprime: the fixed field of ker(epsilon); Delta=Gal(Kprime/K)
definitions.missed: target primes occurring in no ell-active pair as defined in preliminaries.tex
definitions.S: all archimedean places and all primes above ell
definitions.theta: epsilon inverse under the natural action on H1(G_Kprime,Q_ell(1))

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 031 (Uchida’s conjecture for open homomorphisms of Galois groups.; papers: Open Homomorphisms of Global Solvably Closed Galois Groups; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For every odd ell satisfying the stated logarithmic compatibility, the number of missed primes w of B away from ell is at most 2[K:Q], and the total number is at most 2[K:Q]+2. More precisely the first number is at most r1_split(Kprime/K)+r2(K)+g_ell_split(Kprime/K)-1_(epsilon=1).

For every number field F and finite S containing infinity and the primes above ell, unramified-outside-S continuous H1(G_F,Q_ell(1)) is naturally Aut(F,S)-equivariantly isomorphic to O_(F,S)^times tensor Q_ell, without assuming finite support in the completed multiplicative group.

Independent missed-prime Kummer classes remain independent after pullback and restriction to G_Kprime and belong to the epsilon-inverse, not epsilon, eigenspace for the natural Delta action on H1(G_Kprime,Q_ell(1)).
Every restricted missed-prime Kummer class is unramified at every finite prime of Kprime not above ell, including primes ramified in Kprime/K.

For any finite cyclic F/K, finite stable S containing infinity, and one-dimensional Q_ell-valued character theta, the theta multiplicity in O_(F,S)^times tensor Q_ell is sum over S/Delta of 1_(theta trivial on its stabilizer) minus 1_(theta=1). For faithful theta this is r1_split+r2+g_finite_split-1_(theta=1), with the finite sum taken over the specified finite places.

The manuscript normalizer extension beta:G_k->P is surjective, and preserves ell-adic cyclotomic logarithms for every odd prime ell congruent to 1 modulo [k:Q]!. This is an upstream claim not verified in the uniform-bridge mission.

The logarithm-rank lemma lem:log-rank and its Frobenius character-detection consequences prop:character-detection hold with the exact stated hypotheses; these upstream claims remain unaudited in this mission.

The quotient-amplification and Frobenius-generation constructions in generation.tex have the claimed separating-character and generation properties; these upstream claims remain unaudited in this mission.
For all but finitely many split degree-one target primes of B=Q(i), the union of active source partners over eligible ell is finite (lem:finite-fibers).
The simultaneous power-residue separation assertion lem:power-separation holds for the exact displayed prime lists, bounds, and congruence condition.
Almost every target prime of Q(i) above a split rational prime has an active partner with the same rational residue characteristic (prop:same-characteristic).
The normalized map is conjugate to ordinary restriction, and every continuous open G_F->P has this rigidity property, as asserted in identification.tex.
Every continuous open homomorphism between Galois groups of solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields is induced by a unique equivariant field embedding in the opposite direction.
Every restricted missed-prime Kummer class is unramified at every finite prime of Kprime not above ell, including primes ramified in Kprime/K.

external_assumptions.statement: For an open map between the indicated global solvably closed Galois groups and odd ell, surviving pro-ell inertia at a source prime away from ell is case (ii): the full decomposition image lies in a unique finite target decomposition group away from ell, and the pro-ell inertia maps into target inertia. No cofinite-coverage conclusion is used here.
external_assumptions.source: Uchida, JMSJ 33 (1981), primary journal PDF archived at research/literature/uchida1981-journal.pdf.
external_assumptions.locator: Section 1, pp. 595-596, uniqueness and case (ii), with exclusion of case (iii) for odd ell

external_assumptions.statement: For a characteristic-zero field F, finite-level Kummer cohomology identifies H1(G_F,mu_(ell^n)) with F^times/(F^times)^(ell^n); for S-integers the associated exact sequence has S-units and ell^n-torsion in the Picard group.

external_assumptions.statement: The ideal class group of a number field is finite; its quotient, the S-ideal class group, is therefore finite.
external_assumptions.source: J. S. Milne, Algebraic Number Theory, version 3.08, July 19, 2020; archived research/literature/milne-ant.pdf.

external_assumptions.statement: For a finite Galois extension F/K and finite set T of places of K containing infinity, the rational S-unit representation plus one trivial representation is the permutation representation on the places S of F above T; equivalently Q tensor (U_S direct-sum Z) is the sum of the place permutation modules.
external_assumptions.source: Bass, Generators and relations for cyclotomic units, Nagoya Math. J. 27 (1966), archived research/literature/bass1966.pdf.

claims.natural_statement: For a finite totally imaginary Galois M/Q, the additive ell-adic character space contains Ind_(complex conjugation)^Gal(M/Q)(sign), embeds in the regular representation, and has faithful finite Galois action (prop:signed-representation); this upstream assertion is not audited in this mission.
For an active pair (v,w) at an odd ell, (Nv)^b(g)=(Nw)^a(g) in Z_ell^times for all g in D_v (lem:norm-identity); this surrounding local calculation is not certified in the uniform-bridge mission.

The full manuscript uses Uchida 1979 isomorphism rigidity and its centralizer consequence, Uchida 1981 partial local correspondence and embedding uniqueness, Hoshi 2025 Theorem 3.4, and solvable-closure reductions. Their exact applicability is an audit obligation, not a result of this mission; only the odd-prime local input was inspected here.

external_assumptions.statement: For a number field F and finite S containing infinity, the S-unit group is finitely generated; its pro-ell completion therefore rationalizes to U_S tensor Q_ell.
external_assumptions.source: The finite generation assertion is in Bass, Nagoya Math. J. 27 (1966), archived research/literature/bass1966.pdf; the elementary completion consequence is proved in research/uniform_kummer_bridge.md.
external_assumptions.locator: Section 3, Lemma (Dirichlet, Artin-Tate), p. 402, finite generation assertion

routes.retired_because: The full pro-ell completion can contain products product_j p_j^(ell^j) with infinitely many nonzero valuation coordinates. A finite-support shortcut is false; the finite-level S-class-group exact sequence and its multiplication-by-ell transition replace it.
